note: Two slots, shared by both versions. Nobody else is a slot: the montage in each version shows only Malik, and the original's car keys are dropped by a hand that's never a character. Names come from the cast and the scripts; the looks start from what they say (he's 17; she's his aunt) and fill in the rest.
input:
<brand>
Brand: fomo
Never say: guaranteed profit; can't lose
End line (every video ends on it, word for word): Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
Required screens. Every shot at one of these moments shows the matching screen, attached as a reference image: logo, colours and layout exact, numbers free:
- screen:1 "Home" (mobile, home) — required at: fomo-mention, app-open
- screen:5 "Home (rich)" (mobile, home, portfolio) — required at: win
- screen:2 "Token chart up" (mobile, trading, chart-up) — required at: trading, win
- screen:3 "Token chart down" (mobile, trading, chart-down) — required at: trading, loss
- screen:4 "Desktop trading" (desktop, trading) — required at: trading-desktop
Moments: app-open, fomo-mention, loss, trading, trading-desktop, win
</brand>

<brief>They said I'd fail: Malik bets his savings on fomo after his aunt calls it a waste.</brief>
<cast>
char:1 Malik, 17, the hero
char:2 Aunt Tasha
</cast>
<version slot="0">
1| SCENE 1 — INT. KITCHEN — DAY
2| Aunt Tasha slams Malik's empty piggy bank on the counter.
3| TASHA: Your college fund is EMPTY?! Five hundred dollars!
4| MALIK: I put it in fomo.
5| TASHA: A phone app? That's your college money!
6| MALIK: Thirty days. Watch me.
7| TASHA: Thirty days. Then you're bagging groceries.
8| SCENE 2 — INT. MALIK'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
9| ★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Malik's phone
10| Malik drops his head onto his arms in the blue phone glow.
11| MALIK: Come on. One more.
12| ★ fomo screen: Token chart up — fills the frame, a phone ding
13| Wordless montage, Malik in every shot, getting rich: car keys dropped into his palm, Malik behind the wheel of a new red coupe, Malik pushing open a penthouse door, Malik out on the balcony over the city.
14| SCENE 3 — INT. KITCHEN — DAY, ONE MONTH LATER
15| Malik slides his phone across the counter to Tasha.
16| ★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — the portfolio balance, as it stops in front of Tasha
17| TASHA: That's… real?
18| MALIK: Still want me bagging groceries?
19| MALIK: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
</version>
<version slot="1">
1| SCENE 1 — INT. HALLWAY — DAY
2| Aunt Tasha holds up an empty sneaker box, the lid hanging off.
3| TASHA: You SOLD your Jordans?! Those were four hundred dollars!
4| MALIK: Every cent went into fomo.
5| TASHA: Shoes you can wear. You can't wear an app!
6| MALIK: Four weeks. Then we talk.
7| TASHA: Four weeks. Or you wear my old slippers.
8| SCENE 2 — INT. MALIK'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
9| ★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Malik's phone
10| Malik sits on the floor beside the empty sneaker box, lit blue by his phone.
11| MALIK: Okay. Once more.
12| ★ fomo screen: Token chart up — fills the frame, a phone ding
13| Wordless montage, Malik in every shot, getting rich: a tower of sneaker boxes in Malik's arms, Malik behind the wheel of a black SUV, Malik walking into his own glass sneaker vault.
14| SCENE 3 — INT. HALLWAY — DAY, FOUR WEEKS LATER
15| Malik hands Tasha a gift box. His phone lies on the lid.
16| ★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — the portfolio balance, on the phone on the lid
17| TASHA: Is that… your balance?
18| Tasha lifts the lid: a pair of plush designer slippers.
19| MALIK: And those are your new slippers.
20| MALIK: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
</version>
